stem.x: For an automaton with input and output symbols {0, 1} and a state transition diagram shown below, which of the following is the output string for the input string 0011001110? Here, S_{1} represents the initial state, and the label x/y on each arc indicates that if x is an input, then y is the corresponding output at the state transition.

stem.alt: State transition diagram with three states S1, S2, S3 in a row; S1 is the initial state (arrow from the left). S1 has a self-loop labelled 0/0. Arc S1→S2 labelled 1/0. Arc S2→S1 labelled 0/0. Arc S2→S3 labelled 1/1. S3 has a self-loop labelled 1/1. Arc S3→S1 (along the bottom) labelled 0/0.
